neha (Docs): Heads-up: we've got a doc ticket to clean up naming across migration guides (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private). Customers are confused by inconsistent capitalization and mixed terms like 'dedicated capacity' vs 'Dedicated'. Can we align?
omar (Eng): Agreed. From runtime side we call it Dedicated (capital D) in code comments but docs sometimes use lowercase.
tara (Product): Product prefers Title Case for named product modes: Hosted, Dedicated, Private. In paragraphs use lowercase when generic (e.g., 'a dedicated instance' ok). We should document that rule.
mike (DevEx): Proposal: add a single line in style guide: "Use Title Case for official product modes when referring to the product offering (Hosted, Dedicated, Private). Use lowercase for descriptive usage." I'll add a lint rule to catch Title Case use where not allowed.
rachel (Legal): Also watch glossary: current entry 'Private deployment' accidentally says "customer-managed control plane" which is ambiguous. Suggest: "Private deployment — deployment mode where the customer manages networking; Redwood offers an optional control plane component." Keeps it clear and avoids legal overclaim.
neha (Docs): Action items: 1) update docs/style/capitalization.md with the Title Case rule and examples; 2) run a quick grep in docs/* to find inconsistent usages and open fix PRs; 3) touch migration guides with voice examples showing 'Redwood' vs 'we' usage. Volunteers?
omar (Eng): I can do a grep and raise a small PR fixing obvious Title Case mismatches in migration guides.
mike (DevEx): I'll draft the lint rule and a README for reviewers (how to interpret Title Case vs generic).
tara (Product): For migration guides, add an explicit "What's different in wording" note at the top: sample sentences showing Hosted wording vs Private wording (so reviewers know to watch voice shifts). e.g., Hosted: "Redwood provides X"; Private migration steps: "We recommend configuring X".
neha (Docs): Good idea. Also let's add a tiny SDK snippet showing a migration pattern for saving prompts/configs between Hosted and Private (pseudo-code is fine). Keeps docs practical.
omar (Eng): Pseudo-code sample: ```js
// migrate prompt templates from hosted to private
const templates = await redwood.templates.list({scope: 'org'});
await saveToCustomerRepo(templates);
```
rachel (Legal): I'll review PRs for any wording that might imply guarantees. Avoid 'fully isolated' without qualifiers.
neha (Docs): Timeline: I'll open the capitalization/style PR by Wed; omar will open content fixes PRs; mike will have lint ready by Thu. I'll tag legal for reviews.
bot-ci: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 (neha)
mike (DevEx): Quick note: for backlog, we should also normalize glossary keys: use kebab-case or snake_case? I vote for human-friendly titles in UI but file keys are fine. We'll discuss in a follow-up thread.
neha (Docs): Thanks everyone. If you see any other weird phrasing in the migration guides, drop it in this thread and I'll batch-fix. :white_check_mark:
